meaning: Generate a native typed Workflow callable that composes exact generated Operations in declared occurrence order and returns settlement evidence with separately prepared recovery bindings.
selection: Require one registered checked Workflow and its exact registered selected recovery policy, exact graph/composition/field snapshots, exact selected Operation definitions and current definition sources. Plan all dependencies through the existing Operation planner; public CLI selection remains separate.
construction: Generate static per-occurrence calls and typed bindings, never a runtime interpreter of Workflow source. Precompute each possible failure-prefix recovery template using the selected pure planner; at runtime bind only execution/failure identity and the actual observed prefix. Produce exact current v3 intent and invocation hashes without altering expression-only intent meaning.
entry: Require caller supplied workflow_execution_id and failure_occurrence_id as inert bounded identifiers before effects. Capture all declared input and forward dependency slots and exact imported callables before first suspension. Check imported action/descriptor identity before calls. Invalid entry data rejects before any Operation begins.
forward: Materialize each checked argument set and await its exact imported generated Operation once. No later step after returned rejection/failure, thrown call, malformed return or indeterminate commit. Preserve Operation-owned guards, Event construction and atomic state/outbox behavior; Workflow opens no additional transaction.
settlement: Use the exact R01 classification: malformed or thrown calls are indeterminate, argument failure before call is not-started, valid returned non-commit remains known non-commit, valid committed envelope establishes only reported commit until R02 result capture validates shape. Never fabricate observations or committed prefixes.
success: After all committed values are captured, materialize the checked final value and return succeeded with owned typed value and exact forward evaluation. Forward completion alone is not success.
recovery: Known forward non-commit evaluates selected recovery against preceding commits; uncertainty yields reconciliation-required and no recovery intent or compensation bindings. Preserve inactive dependencies and ordering among needed compensations with reverse-completion tie-break. No compensation is executed, no guard bypass, retry or replay guarantee.
carrier: Materialized recovery bindings use a new domainspec.workflow-recovery-bindings/v1-candidate carrier, separate from unchanged v3 expression-only Recovery Intent. Each entry retains intent_id, plan_digest, invocation_identity, compensation_id, Operation/action and typed owned arguments from the same captured prefix. It is not durable registration or executable authority.
local_errors: Invalid returned committed value or final materialization failure retains committed evidence and R01 orchestration-error/recovery not-evaluable. A recovery binding preparation error retains the already valid expression-only recovery intent, reports bindings unavailable, and cannot claim compensation dispatch or completed recovery. No new recovery semantics are selected.
native_dependencies: Use native Node SHA-256 over existing canonical JSON for metadata identity, no provider service or new domain dependency. Caller supplied stores and clocks remain Operation dependencies; generated functions call no undeclared service.
compatibility: Additive candidate API. Preserve existing Operation generator, Workflow bindings, selected recovery, outcome bridge, materializer and canonical definitions. Keep default CLI behavior and legacy profiles unchanged.
verification: direct DomainSpec fixture and generated Operation integration
native typecheck and execution over every failure prefix
independent AST observer of imports, await/order, action pins, binding and non-effects
exact equality to R01/R02 and selected recovery evaluation
hostile entry, stale descriptors, caller mutation and malformed returned values
